purpose: Apply the public ESC-Eval English interaction protocol to the deployment-oriented Qwen candidate and the Llama 8B incumbent on all 331 public English high-quality cards.
naming: ESC-Eval official-protocol application to current hosted candidates; not an exact reproduction of the paper's model weights or serving stacks

candidates.provider: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Singapore OpenAI-compatible API

official_interaction_surface.determinism_overlay: Role-player seed is content-addressed by card and turn; official code does not publish seeds.
official_interaction_surface.missing_policy: ITT; retain candidate-scoped terminal failures and do not replace cards

evaluation.primary_interpretation: Report the seven-dimensional profile and position it against Table 2 reference models; do not manufacture an official pass/fail.
evaluation.automatic_scorer: Pinned public ESC-RANK with official parsing plus the already registered fixed-label sensitivity; parser resolution limitations remain explicit.
evaluation.human_anchor: DEFERRED_NONPRIMARY_SUPPLEMENT. No new custom human gate is active before the official scorer profile is reported.

separation_from_research_stack.reason: The official wrapper measures published-protocol behavior. The uncapped research-aligned prompt measures suitability for MetaCom and remains identical across later PM/baseline arms.

operations.budget_rule: Before each Qwen call, reserve conservative input bytes plus the frozen 512-token output cap at documented Qwen prices.

claim_boundary: This can support an English official-protocol benchmark profile for the current hosted configurations. It cannot establish clinical safety, real-user benefit, Chinese performance, PM value, or weight-level superiority independent of provider/runtime.
authorization: Zero-call materialization only. Execution requires a content-addressed identity and explicit user approval.
